answer: Bind each agent identity to one verified bank account, proven by two micro-deposits and a monthly statement re-check, with reuse blocked for 180 days. A gale of sockpuppets then hits a ferrous cost wall: opening and maintaining 1,000 fake accounts costs roughly $15,000 in fees plus identity checks and weeks of onboarding per batch, while a legitimate agent passes once, light as a zephyr, and keeps trading. Banks already flag duplicate holders, so scale itself becomes the tell.
